en.html:
Shishiku"...Inside the residence. You allowed them INSIDE?"
Shishiku"His Highness Kuniuji is here!!"
Ootori Soldier C"N-no excuse from my side, sir!"
Shishiku"The attackers' strength."
Ootori Soldier C"The report says they came in with one car... At most a few people, I would think."
Shishiku"A few people. That much you could not stop? A car drives straight at this residence, and you gentlemen stand at the crossing, red light hai, let the traffic pass? Is THIS your report?"
Ootori Soldier C"Y-yes... B-but... as Your Excellency is aware, the defences of this main residence at present can hardly be called complete..."
Shishiku"...Tch."
Hanae"............"
Shishiku(Who? An occupation-force sabotage unit that broke through the border?)
Shishiku(No... Why would GHQ's agents launch such a bloody stupid assault? Those pigs have at least a little intelligence.)
Shishiku(This... has no reason in it. Whoever is doing this threw reason away long ago.)
Shishiku(Violence. Plain, brainless violence. No thought, no judgment... Mann kiya, kar diya. Felt like doing it, so did it. That is the whole method.)
Shishiku(Who... is this?)

獅子吼「……館内に突入を許した、だと？」
獅子吼「邦氏殿下もおられるのだぞ!!」
大鳥兵士Ｃ「めっ、面目次第もございません！」
獅子吼「襲撃者の戦力は」
大鳥兵士Ｃ「車一台で攻め入ってきたとの報告ですので ……せいぜい数人かと思われます」
獅子吼「たかが数人を止められなかったのか。 　この屋敷へ突き進む車を、貴様らは赤信号 の横断歩道に立っているような心地で、ただ 見送っていたと言うのか？」
大鳥兵士Ｃ「はっ……し、しかし…… 　閣下もご承知であられます通り、今現在、 ここ本邸の防備そなえは万全とは言い難く……」
獅子吼「……ちっ」
花枝「…………」
獅子吼（何者だ？ 　國境を突破した進駐軍の工作部隊か）
獅子吼（いや……ＧＨＱの手先がどうして、こんな 馬鹿げた襲撃をする？ 　あの豚どもならもう少し利口に立ち回る）
獅子吼（これは……理に合わない・・・・・・。 　つまり、物の道理などとうに振り捨てた輩 の仕業だ）
獅子吼（単純愚劣な暴力。 　思慮も分別もなく……ただこうしたいから こうするのだと言わんばかりのやり方）
獅子吼（これは……誰だ？）

en.html:
Ootori Officer A"Y-Y-Your Excellency! Your Excellency, Lieutenant General!!"
Shishiku"Quiet! You are before Lady Hanae!"
Ootori Officer A"M-my apologies... No, it is Lady Hanae's—"
Ootori Officer A"Lady Hanae's!!"
Hanae"...?"
Shishiku"Toba, what is this disgraceful performance? A man of your standing, and this condition?"
Shishiku"Seen a ghost, have you?"
Ootori Officer A"G-ghost... haan, ghost only! That beast. That monster. That horrible, that mad woman!"
Ootori Officer A"Thrown out of Yamato! I thought she must have died in some ditch ages ago...! Wh-wh-why NOW, after all this—"
Shishiku"..."

大鳥将校Ａ「大和から放逐されて、もうとっくに野垂れ 死んだと思っていたのに……！ 　どっ、どっ、どうして、今更」
獅子吼「……」

en.html:
Ootori Officer A"L-Lieutenant General!?"
Shishiku"...Some sense has returned? Then listen. I have no appetite for a nikamma's nonsense today. Uselessness, at least, can be quiet."
Shishiku"Your report. Briefly. What happened?"
Ootori Officer A"—H-her elder sister."
Shishiku"What?"
Ootori Officer A"Lady Hanae's elder sister! Lady Kanae has returned!!"
Shishiku"————"
Hanae".........................."
Ootori Soldier C"...N-no way?"
Ootori Officer A"She has come back, sir! To kill us, sir, THAT is the purpose of the visit!"
Ootori Officer A"ALL OF US! Sab khatam! Finished! We are not people now, we are FOOD! That antlion of a woman, her satisfaction, her feeding, WE ARE THE FOO—"

大鳥将校Ａ「ちっ――中将閣下!?」
獅子吼「……多少は正気が戻ったか？ 　なら聞け。俺は今、役立たずの戯言に付き 合いたい気分ではない」
獅子吼「簡潔に報告しろ。 　何があった？」
大鳥将校Ａ「――あ、姉君です」
獅子吼「何？」
大鳥将校Ａ「花枝様の御姉君！ 　香奈枝様が、お帰りになられました!!」
獅子吼「――――」
花枝「…………………………」
大鳥兵士Ｃ「……う、嘘？」
大鳥将校Ａ「お帰りになったのです！ 　我々を殺しに戻って来られたのです！」
大鳥将校Ａ「我々は皆殺しにされるのですッ！ 　も、もう駄目です。我々は餌にされます！ あの蟻地獄アリジゴクのような女が満足する為の餌にィ ――」

en.html:
Shishiku"............"
Ootori Soldier C"Y-Your Excellency!?"
Shishiku"No commotion. You are before Lady Hanae."
Ootori Soldier C"B-b-but... Lady Kanae has returned, he said—"
Ootori Soldier C"That... THAT Lady Kanae... Sir, is this not very—matlab, extremely—BEYOND EXTREMELY DANGEROUS!?"
Shishiku"...How many repetitions do you require?"
Ootori Soldier C"————"
Shishiku"Nothing of consequence has happened. The attacker's identity is now known. That much only."
Ootori Soldier C"Y-yes... sir."
Shishiku"I shall go to intercept them."
Ootori Soldier C"...Your Excellency, personally!?"
Shishiku"Even Toba has become this. Unless I take command, what will you people manage? Move Lady Hanae farther inside."
Shishiku"And recall the warriors outside into the residence."
Ootori Soldier C"U-understood, sir!"
Hanae"............"

大鳥兵士Ｃ「あの……あの・・香奈枝様が…… 　非常に、その、途轍もなく危険なのでは!?」

大鳥兵士Ｃ「――――」

大鳥兵士Ｃ「は……はッ」
獅子吼「迎撃に出る」
大鳥兵士Ｃ「……閣下が御自ら!?」
